'''Corellian Corporate Council Tower''' was the headquarters of the [[Corellian Corporate Council]], located in the [[Incorporation Islands]] of the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] stormed the tower to retrieve the head of the council Chairman [[Harlon Fane]] for [[Darth Tormen]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corellian Corporate Council Tower appears as an area on Corellia in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
